title: Express.js Exercises
description: Read each example in its lesson first. Predict the result, then check your answer. The notes explain the idea and one common mistake.

exercises.question: A route pairs a method and path with a function. Open GET / to receive this text. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The GET path matches /. Express passes request and response objects to the handler, which sends the greeting. The method and path must both match the route.

exercises.question: JSON is a text format for named data. GET /book returns a small object. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: res.json serialises the title and pages fields and sets a JSON response type. Use res.json for data so Express sets the JSON content type.

exercises.question: A colon marks a path input. GET /hello/Ravi places Ravi in req.params.name. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The path segment Ravi is captured under name. The template string inserts that captured text. Path inputs arrive as text; do not trust them as numbers automatically.

exercises.question: Query values follow ? in a URL. Visit GET /search?q=cat to read q. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The string check accepts cat as q. The handler puts it under the term field. A query value can have an unexpected shape; check it before use.

exercises.question: POST can send a body. Send POST /books with Content-Type application/json and body {"title":"Moon Trip"}. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: express.json has already parsed the body. The title check passes, so status 201 and that title are returned. express.json must run before routes that read a JSON body.

exercises.question: A route value needs checks before maths. GET /double/4 returns a doubled whole number. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: Number parses the text 4. The integer check passes, and the returned answer is twice 4. Number() can fail or produce decimals; check the allowed kind of value.

exercises.question: Middleware runs before a later handler when it calls next. GET / shows the value this middleware placed in res.locals. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The shared middleware sets school on this response and calls next. The handler reads that value. Middleware must send a response or call next; otherwise the request waits.

exercises.question: A Router groups routes under a shared prefix. GET /api/books uses both the prefix and inner path. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: Mounting at /api combines with /books, creating /api/books. The mounted prefix is part of the final URL.

exercises.question: A status code tells the client what happened. GET /books/99 returns 404 because this practice item is absent. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The handler explicitly sets 404 before sending its one error field. Set the status before sending the response body.

exercises.question: A redirect asks the client to visit another URL. GET /start points to /hello; a browser follows it. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The first handler sends Location: /hello. The following request receives Welcome. A redirect is a new request, not an internal function call.

exercises.question: An error handler has four inputs. GET /broken throws an error, which the last handler turns into a clear reply. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: The thrown error skips normal routing and reaches the four-input error handler. Place error middleware after the routes and avoid exposing private error details.

exercises.question: A final middleware can reply when no earlier route matched. GET /missing reaches this fallback. What result does this example give after the setup steps?
exercises.explanation: No route matches /missing, so the final middleware supplies a 404 text reply. Put the fallback last so it does not hide real routes.
